spec.expr:
sum by (interface, direction) (
  label_replace(
    label_replace(
      nexus_interfaces_ucastPkts,
      "interface",
      "$1",
      "dn",
      "sys/intf/phys-\\[([^ ]+)\\].*"
    ),
    "direction",
    "$1",
    "dn",
    ".*dbgIfHC(In|Out)"
  )
)
* on(interface) group_left(operSt, accessVlan, allowedVlans) 
min by (interface, operSt, accessVlan, allowedVlans) (
  label_replace(
    nexus_interfaces_vdcId,
    "interface",
    "$1",
    "dn",
    "sys/intf/phys-\\[([^ ]+)\\].*"
  )
)

min by (interface, operSt, accessVlan, allowedVlans, operMode) (
  label_replace(
    nexus_interfaces_vdcId,
    "interface",
    "$1",
    "dn",
    "sys/intf/phys-\\[([^ ]+)\\].*"
  )
)
